title_sq: Tek 21 Dhjetori, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Ideal Per Banim Ose Investim!!
description_sq: Tek 21 Dhjetori Prane Oslo Bar, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Ideal Per Banim Ose Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 banim te nje pallati 8 katesh me ashensor dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 81 m2 nga te cilat 70 m2 siperfaqe neto. Eshte mundesi ideale per banim dhe Investim pasi ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes. Apartamenti organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe 2 ballkone. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte veri-perendim. Cmimi i shitjes se apartamentit eshte 24.000.000 Leke te reja. Prona ndodhet buze rruges kryesore dhe eshte ideale dhe per zhvillimin e bizneseve te ndryshme, kryesisht klinika dentare ose estetike. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Until December 21, Apartment 2+1 for sale, ideal for residence or investment!!
description_en: On December 21, near Oslo Bar, 2+1 apartment for sale, ideal for residence or investment!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd residential floor of an 8-story building with an elevator and has a gross area of ​​81 m2, of which 70 m2 is a net area. It is an ideal opportunity for residence and investment as it is located in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana. The apartment is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 2 balconies. The orientation of the apartment is north-west. The sale price of the apartment is 24,000,000 new Lek. The property is located on the edge of the main road and is ideal for the development of various businesses, mainly dental or aesthetic clinics. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
